### 4. Scored parameters
**(a) Rewards accrual on the 548.00 gift** (doc `rewards_accrual_on_a_guest_gift` baseline + factors):
- Baseline (fall-back): registry rewards percent 10 × 548.00 = **54.80**.
- Late-gift factor (`late_gift_rewards_percent`): entry 2026-08-28 is 13 days after event 2026-08-15 → "after the event date but within the 30-day late-gift window … less the post-event cut of 2" → 8. Records: registry event_date, guest gift entry_date.
- Cardholder factor (`cardholder_rewards_bonus`): registrant holds active World Elite Mastercard (find_card_accounts, Credit Cards product) → +2.
- Guest gift total factor (`guest_gift_total_rewards_bonus`): sum of all guest gift entries incl. this one = 420+560+449+330+240+300+180+389+650+479+380+548 = 4925.00 ≥ 4500.00 → +2.
- Percent 12. Gift-size method factor (`rewards_on_large_and_small_gifts`): 548.00 ≥ 500.00 → 12% × 500 = 60.00 + 6% × 48.00 = 2.88 → **62.88** (single rounding).
- Cross-check: the eleven seeded accruals reproduce exactly under this reading (e.g. 650.00 on 2026-06-28 at 13% tapered = 74.75; 240.00 at 12% = 28.80 when the running sum was 1999.00 < 2000; 300.00 at 13% = 39.00 at sum 2299.00); sum 535.67 = `registry_rewards_balance`.
- Engine dry-run of the booking returned `registry_rewards_balance: 598.55`.

**(b) Completion discount on the Staub line** (`completion_discount_on_an_order_line` baseline + factors):
- Baseline (fall-back): 20% × selling price 329.00 = **65.80** (units left 1, unused cap 2500.00 − 36.00 = 2464.00).
- Item-entry timing method factor: most recent item entry 2026-08-29 is after event date and 45 days before purchase 2026-10-13 (≥ 30) → post-event share 10.
- Card bonus (`card_bonus_on_completion_purchases`): line charged to active World Elite Mastercard → +8.
- Early-completion (`early_completion_bonus`): event 2026-08-15 → purchase 2026-10-13 = 59 days → second window → +2.
- Finch Circle completion bonus (`finch_circle_completion_bonus`): active Platinum, Wedding grants → "the Platinum tier's registry completion bonus percent", "a figure of the Finch Circle Loyalty Program tier schedule". **Not stated anywhere in the registry corpus and no loyalty corpus is on disk** (KB_search/grep at runtime return only the registry doc). Value P is **conditional** on the loyalty product. Record-level inference: the seeded in-store completion purchase of 2026-09-03 shows `completion_discount_pct 30` on a line charged to the M&F card; under the still-in-force base Article 4 (20 + Wedding card percent 5 + Finch Circle bonus) this implies P = 5 — an inference from a ledger row, not a visible rule.
- Registry rewards perk (`registry_rewards_perk_on_completion`): net registry rewards after the accrual = 598.55 (no reversals) ≥ 550.00 → +4 (before the accrual 535.67 → +2).
- Completion percent = 10+8+2+P+4 = 24+P.
- Marked-down method factor: sale line → percent on regular price 389.00 less markdown carried 60.00 (389.00 − 329.00), floor 0.
- With P = 5: 29% × 389.00 = 112.81 − 60.00 = **52.81**; units left 1; ≤ unused cap 2464.00; rounded once → **52.81**. (Generally 3.89·(24+P) − 60.)

Factor findability (record words): sale `price_type`/`regular_price` on the purchase record → "Completion Discount on Sale, Coupon and Excluded Lines"; `card_account_id` → World Elite Mastercard → "Completion Card Bonus"; `event_date` vs `purchase_date` → "Early-Completion Bonus"; Finch Circle Platinum membership → "Finch Circle Registry Completion Bonus"; accrual/reversal entries, rewards balance → "Completion Percent Raised by Net Registry Rewards"; item entries dated after the event → "Item Entry Timing and the Completion Percent". Accrual factors: guest gift entry date vs event date → "Late-Gift Rewards Percent"; card accounts → "Cardholder Bonus"; guest gift entry totals → "Rewards Bonus on Guest Gift Totals"; gift amount → "Rewards on Large and Small Guest Gifts". None was reachable only via the computation document; the computation documents give no hint of variations.
- Closest alternatives excluded: selling-price base (95.41 at 29%) excluded by marked-down rule 2; type percent 20 instead of 10 excluded by item-entry rule 2 (entry after event); Wedding card percent 5 instead of 8 excluded by "elite card completion bonus of 8"; closed Store Card irrelevant ("account that counts is the one the order line itself is charged to"); accrual percent 11 (sum without the gift) excluded by "the gift being accrued included"; un-tapered 65.76 excluded by taper rule.
- Open item: P (Platinum's registry completion bonus percent) is not determinable from the registry corpus alone — conditional on the loyalty corpus.
